name: Trailing return breach
condition: The cumulative return of the trailing settled weeks is negative
data_required: Weekly return series for the strategy, from settled bets
note: A live strategy that is losing is sent back to paper while the loss is investigated. It is not disqualified: a losing streak is not evidence of a broken rule.

name: Sample sufficiency
condition: The number of settled weeks is below the number the power gate requires
action: PAPER (a strategy may never be live below this)
data_required: Settled-week count and the power requirement from G3
note: A return computed on too few weeks cannot be told apart from luck, so it cannot support a live tier in the first place.

name: Signal failure
condition: The lower bound of the signal edge is not above zero
data_required: Hit rate, per-bet prices and the break-even rate
note: This is the mirror of the leaderboard's signal scorecard. A strategy whose signal has stopped working is demoted even if its money is still positive.

name: Drawdown limit
condition: The peak-to-trough drawdown is worse than the floor
data_required: Weekly return series for the strategy
note: A drawdown floor bounds the damage a decaying strategy can do before it is reviewed.

name: Price provenance loss
condition: A settled bet has no verified executable price
threshold: any bet without a verified quote
data_required: Quote timestamp, price, limits and an official quote reference for each settled bet
note: The price is what the return is measured against. A bet that cannot be priced cannot be settled, so it cannot keep a live tier.

name: Result provenance loss
condition: A settled bet has no official final on record
threshold: any bet without an official result
data_required: The official final score and the official page it was read from, in the verified results feed
note: A settlement without an official result is a guess. The repository grades forward picks against official finals only.

name: Leakage or undisclosed rule change
condition: A leakage check fails, or the rule changed without a new strategy id
action: DISQUALIFIED (never live again for this id)
data_required: The leakage test suite and the frozen rule of each registered strategy
note: The only irreversible condition. Leakage and undisclosed rule changes are not a performance question.

name: Redundancy
condition: The selection overlap with an existing live strategy reaches the redundancy limit
note: A duplicate of a live strategy is not a second source of return; it is the same one counted twice.
